title: HarmonySeg: Tubular Structure Segmentation with Deep-Shallow Feature Fusion and Growth-Suppression Balanced Loss
mechanism: Vesselness map fused with image via deep mutual query and shallow query attention; growth-suppression loss: relaxed supervision outside annotated regions, reconnection pseudo-labels, spatial feature prior, mixup equivalence; built for incomplete labels.
adaptation: Use only the loss: no background penalty within 3 px of crack labels (relaxed term) plus mixup-equivalence consistency; add attention fusion of a ridge map only if the vesselness-input arm shows a signal.
min_experiment: Arm: house + relaxed term + mixup-equivalence, 5 seeds; baseline house. Metric relR@2 at matched relP@2, crack IoU. Kill: relR@2 gain < 0.01 at equal relP@2.
evidence: Hepatic vessels: GSB lifts nnU-Net Dice 60.15 -> 64.00 (terms +2.94, +1.11, +1.67, +2.01 alone); D2SD +5.1 Dice; beats DSC-Net and SR-loss nnU-Net on 3 of 4 external strata; plain concatenation of vesselness gave no notable gain.
prior_overlap: Offset-tolerant CE (n.d.) is close to the relaxed term (partly closed); mixup-equivalence and reconnection terms untested

alt_notes.adaptation: Compute a multi-scale dark-ridge Hessian map (Sato or Frangi, sigma 1 to 3 px) per cell. Feed it as a parallel stream, not by concatenation, since their ablation found concatenation useless. The relaxed-supervision term fits our missed or partial crack labels (24 of 239 audited cells were flagged).
alt_notes.min_experiment: Ridge-stream fusion vs a concat control vs house, 5 seeds. Metrics: test crack relF1@2 and E1 crack recall. Kill if it beats neither the concat control nor house by >= 0.012.
